          "model (e.g., gpt-4o, o3)",

      {
        "api_name": "Assistants API (Beta)",

          "file_search",
          "function"
        ],
        "parameters_for_chatbots": [
          "model (e.g., gpt-4o)",
          "instructions (system instructions)",

          "tool_resources (e.g., file IDs for code interpreter, vector store IDs for file search)",
          "temperature",
          "top_p",
          "response_format"

        "api_name": "Realtime API (Beta)",

          "model (e.g., gpt-4o-realtime-preview)",
          "modalities (e.g., audio, text)",
          "instructions (system instructions)",
          "voice (e.g., alloy, sage)",
          "input_audio_format (e.g., pcm16, g711_ulaw)",
